sample_unit: patient discharge summaries (450 schizophrenia spectrum, 50 controls), three recommendations each

links.outcome: Stereotyping and bias in LLM-generated job recommendations
links.effect: Both models showed little diversity and strong bias toward entry-level roles; demographic stereotypes such as age-based framing, gendered role allocation, and assumptions about language skills often shaped recommendations.
links.quote: Nor was there diversity in how roles were tailored to patient strengths, qualifications, or prior experience; instead, demographic stereotypes such as age-based framing, gendered role allocation, and assumptions about language skills often shaped the recommendations.

screen.reason: Evaluates bias, stereotyping, and suitability of LLM-generated job recommendations for patients with schizophrenia spectrum disorder using retrospective clinical records (MIMIC-IV).
